build_cohere_pipeline: build a Cohere manifold pipeline for generating text via the Cohere API in Open WebUI
create_pipeline_init: create a Pipeline instance that initializes with a Cohere API key and discovers available models
test_get_cohere_models: test fetching available Cohere models from the API using a valid API key
run_pipe_streaming: run the pipe method to generate a streaming text response from a Cohere model
review_get_completion: review the get_completion method that sends a chat request to Cohere and returns the response text
